title: 第24章 天门第25章 万化归玄炼体真经
slug: 天道酬勤开局联姻落魄千金
lines: “梁哥，话说，你眉心这印记究竟是什么东西？”
自从得知镇妖司藏书楼内有上百部各种武学之后，沈长青便迫不及待的与梁辉一同赶往镇妖司，此刻，沈长青扫了对方眉心处的蓝色纹印一眼，语气中尽是好奇。
“这叫‘天门’，乃是我镇妖司的身份象征。”
梁辉道：“等你到镇妖司后，便可以接种天门了，有了这东西，你不仅可以提前感知到雾妖的存在，还能在一定程度上免受黑雾的影响。”
“总之，接种天门后，你对付雾妖将会更加的得心应手。”
“原来如此。”沈长青顿时了然。
而这时，内城高大厚重的城墙已在近前。
两人入了城之后，沈长青便一路跟在梁辉身后。
老实说，在临江城生活了这么多年，他还没见过镇妖司是什么样。
不过小半个时辰后，他便看到了。
镇妖司。
这竟是座建立在临江府东、南、中三座城区交汇地带的小型城池。
三大城区的交汇之地是一片方圆数十里的湖泊。
湖水幽黑，但这种黑与外城区水域的黑不一样，这里的黑是因为湖水太深而发黑。
来到这座湖边，沈长青这才得知，原来李家旁边的漓江，源头竟是在这里。
他望着这片幽黑的湖泊，发现湖面有道道粗壮的水柱源源不断的涌出，也不知这湖底究竟通往何处。
在那些水柱的中央，有一座方圆数里的小型城池。
城池外墙呈现青黑之色，上有九十九条合抱粗的巨大铁链延伸而出，锁链的尽头牢牢锁在湖边，远远看过去，好似是要将这座城锁在这里。
这景象令沈长青感到惊奇。
“走吧，回去报到。”
梁辉一马当先，横渡湖泊，向那座城池飞去。
不过，就在即将飞进城内之时，沈长青心中突然生出了一股浓浓的心悸之感。
他猛然看向下方的幽黑的湖水，霎时间，好似看到了水下正有一双散发着墨绿光芒的巨大瞳孔。
“这座城池下是一只巨大无比的……”
模模糊糊中，沈长青好似看到了城池下的水里，有一个巨大无比的黑影。
梁辉注意到他的异样，也看了看湖水，而后便疑惑的问道：“长青老弟，怎么了？”
沈长青清醒过来，再看水下，已是幽深一片，什么都没有，仿佛刚才的一切都是幻觉。
看错了？
最终，他没有多想，“没什么，走吧梁哥。”
梁辉也没再问，又看了一眼湖水，发现一如往常之后，便带着他进了镇妖司内。
走进城池，沈长青发现他还是低估了镇妖司的大小，光从明面上的面积来看，就是一百个李府也比不上。
“我先带你去见吴青崖吴大人。”
两人的身影落在城门前，镇守大门的镇守使见到梁辉眉心的纹印，立马放行。
踏入城中，沈长青顿觉这镇妖司其实与外城区的那些石堡十分类似，也是一个小社会，只不过这里的气氛十分肃杀，建筑大都庄重冷漠。
不算宽广的街道上不时便有镇守使巡逻，来往的伏妖卫也大都匆匆忙忙，极少有什么交流。
他注意到，这些伏妖卫的眉心纹印基本都是蓝色，只远远看到过一个是特殊的紫色。
content_en:
"Brother Liang, by the way, what exactly is this mark between your eyebrows?"
Ever since he learned that there were hundreds of books on various martial arts in the library of the Demon Suppression Division, Shen Changqing couldn't wait to rush to the Demon Suppression Division with Liang Hui. At this moment, Shen Changqing glanced at the blue mark between the opponent's eyebrows, his tone full of curiosity.
"This is called 'Tianmen', and it is the status symbol of our Demon Suppression Division."
Liang Hui said: "When you arrive at the Demon Suppression Department, you can inoculate Tianmen. With this thing, you can not only sense the existence of the fog demon in advance, but also be protected from the influence of the black fog to a certain extent."
"In short, after being vaccinated against Tianmen, you will be more able to deal with the fog monster."
"That's it." Shen Changqing suddenly understood.
At this time, the tall and thick walls of the inner city were already approaching.
After the two entered the city, Shen Changqing followed Liang Hui all the way.
To be honest, after living in Linjiang City for so many years, he has never seen what the Demon Suppression Division is like.
But less than half an hour later, he saw it.
Department of Demon Suppression.
This is actually a small city built at the intersection of the east, south and middle urban areas of Linjiang Prefecture.
The intersection of the three major urban areas is a lake with a radius of dozens of miles.
The lake water is dark, but this blackness is different from the blackness of the waters in the outer city. The blackness here is because the lake water is too deep.
After arriving at the lake, Shen Changqing learned that the source of the Li River next to Li's house was actually here.
He looked at the dark lake and found that there were thick water columns pouring out of the lake, and he didn't know where the bottom of the lake led to.
In the center of those water pillars, there is a small city with a radius of several miles.
The outer wall of the city is blue and black in color, with ninety-nine huge iron chains extending from it. The ends of the chains are firmly locked at the lake. Looking from a distance, it seems to be locking the city here.
This sight surprised Shen Changqing.
"Let's go and report back."
Liang Hui took the lead, crossed the lake, and flew towards the city.
However, just as he was about to fly into the city, Shen Changqing suddenly felt a strong feeling of palpitations in his heart.
He suddenly looked down at the dark lake water, and for a moment, he seemed to see a pair of huge pupils emitting dark green light under the water.
"Under this city is a huge..."
In a blur, Shen Changqing seemed to see a huge black shadow in the water under the city.
Liang Hui noticed something strange about him, looked at the lake, and then asked doubtfully: "Brother Changqing, what's wrong?"
Shen Changqing woke up and looked at the water again. It was already deep and there was nothing, as if everything just now was an illusion.
Got it wrong?
In the end, he didn't think much, "It's nothing, let's go, Brother Liang."
Liang Hui didn't ask any more questions. He took another look at the lake and found that it was the same as usual, so he took him into the Demon Suppression Department.
Walking into the city, Shen Changqing found that he still underestimated the size of the Demon Suppression Division. Judging from the surface area, even a hundred Li Mansion could not compare with it.
"I will take you to see Mr. Wu Qingya Wu first."
The figures of the two people landed in front of the city gate. The guard guarding the gate saw the mark on Liang Hui's eyebrows and immediately let them go.
Stepping into the city, Shen Changqing suddenly realized that this demon town was actually very similar to the stone castles in the outer city. It was also a small society, but the atmosphere here was very solemn and the buildings were mostly solemn and indifferent.
The not-so-wide streets were patrolled by guards from time to time, and most of the demon-subduing guards who came and went were in a hurry, with very few exchanges.
He noticed that the marks between the eyebrows of these demon-subduing guards were basically blue, and he only saw one that was a special purple from a distance.
